data.body: ORCHESTRATOR NOTE (2026-08-11): check:seed is no longer a stub. MRQ-62 (merged d16523c) replaced scripts/checks/stub-command.mjs with a real scripts/checks/check-seed.mjs, but it asserts ONLY the venue slice: >=2 pinned buildings, >=1 non-zero access_minutes, Online stays unpinned, and >=1 live Transit conflict. EXTEND it, do not rewrite it — those venue assertions are AC-259's seed gate and deleting them re-opens the defect MRQ-62 was minted to fix. What is still missing and belongs to you: the B-3 assertion that the organizer demo persona's review queue returns >=20 unreviewed candidates (the check that keeps walkthrough step 8 from going dead), plus the rest of the SPEC section 6 shape/scale and deliberate-ugliness assertions over the public API. Until you land, a green check:seed means only 'the venues are real', which reads as broader coverage than it has.

MRQ-23 complete at exact HEAD `78f227a52ca43910d57de044a9e21c48ff0fe32`; Forgejo PR #32 is open: https://forgejo.stage11.ai/atin/marquee/pulls/32

Implemented the ordered `env.DB.batch(...)` wipe in `tests/integration/apply-migrations.ts` with the existing FK-safe `WIPE_ORDER`; no DROP TABLE. The existing `check-seed.mjs` wrapper and all four MRQ-62 venue assertions remain. Added the B-3 organizer reviewer queue assertion (40 seeded unreviewed, API queue >=20), SPEC shape/scale/ugliness checks, the real local Wrangler speed harness, AC-tagged evidence, and `tests/ac-claims/MRQ-23.json`.

A/B after the batch conversion, same machine and fresh `npm ci`:
- `npm test`: 23.38s before -> 14.56s after (-8.82s, 38% faster).
- full `npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-23`: 27.53s before -> 21.75s after (-5.78s, 21% faster).
The wipe conversion is materially beneficial. The final standalone `npm test` was 24.02s wall with 173 Vitest tests and 36 Node tests passing; the final full-gate run below passed in 18.311s.

Mandatory final command: `npm run pr-gate -- --ticket MRQ-23`
```json
{
  "command": "pr-gate",
  "ticket": "MRQ-23",
  "status": "pass",
  "elapsedMs": 18311,
  "budgetMs": 30000
}
```
The final gate also passed worker/client/test type checks, production build, design check, 33 Vitest files / 173 Vitest tests, 36 Node tests, and merged AC trace with 0 uncovered claims and 0 errors. `check:seed` passed in 21.146s / 30s; `check:speed` passed in 51.589s / 240s with all AC budgets passing and no objective warnings.

`speed-report.json` records `check_seed`, `check_speed`, and `pr_gate` wall clocks with budgets and explicitly identifies `local-wrangler-dev` / `wrangler dev/miniflare`, real seed, and `deployed: false`. Deployment-only measurements are a named MRQ-57 checklist in the PR body. The per-file Worker/Miniflare isolate/schema boot tax and possible integration-file consolidation are named as a follow-up in the PR body, not silently expanded into this ticket.

data.body: ORCHESTRATOR NOTE (post-merge, 2026-08-11) — for the end-of-run audit fix, NOT a reopen. The code-quality audit (sequence/code-quality-audit.md) found that the shipped seed writes ZERO submission_answers and ZERO attachments across all 1,000 submissions, so every reviewer detail screen renders 'Not answered' and 'No files attached'. It reads green today because the AC-244 test builds its own fixture carrying the answer the seed never writes — the same green-test-dead-feature shape as the venue-coordinates defect. Your scripts/checks/seed.ts is the natural home for the assertion half: when that fix is tackled at the end of the run, 'seeded submission_answers > 0' and 'seeded attachments > 0' belong beside the existing >=20-unreviewed (B-3) and venue assertions, so the fix has somewhere to prove itself and cannot regress silently. Per operator ruling this is deliberately NOT being injected mid-flight — six delegators are editing these files and the contention cost outweighs landing it early. Recorded here so the end-of-run ticket inherits the placement rather than rediscovering it.
